form.p: Load (or reset) the VendorGuard demo scenario: a vendor with a recent bank-account swap, a pending large payment, a near-threshold purchase order, a three-way-match mismatch ready to block on Confirm, a second vendor sharing its bank account, and two vendors seeded with synthetic bill history for the Benford's Law and chi-square statistical audit. Safe to run repeatedly — it always resets to a clean, demoable state.

Structuring beat: the seeded purchase order alone stays under the threshold on purpose — it only blocks once you create and confirm a second PO for the same vendor live, so the block happens in front of the audience instead of already having happened before you start talking.
